Falsetto quality (thin folds, breathier than M2-modal)
Sob quality (low larynx + thin folds — operatic cry configuration)
Oral twang (AES narrowed for high-F2 brightness, velum closed)
Nasal twang (AES narrowed + velar port open)

Belt quality (high larynx + thick folds + AES narrowing + head-neck anchoring)
Rhythmic spoken flow (no pitch target, rhythmic only)

Arab mawwāl + maqam ornament rules (improvised melismatic pre-metric, layali vocable, maqam modulation jins-change mid-phrase)

Quranic tajwid pitch-and-duration rules (tahqiq slow-melismatic, tarteel measured, tadwir medium-tempo, hadr fast, madd vowel-elongation 2-4-6 counts, qalqalah bounce-articulation, ghunnah nasalization)
